sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Usage Of Web Request Commands And Cmdlets
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects the use of various web request commands with commandline tools and Windows PowerShell cmdlets (including aliases) via CommandLine
sigma_analysis_results.rule_author: James Pemberton / @4A616D6573, Endgame, JHasenbusch, oscd.community, Austin Songer @austinsonger

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis:
The script first checks for the existence of a file named `/usr/bin/linux`.
If this file does not exist, the script performs the following actions:
1.  It initiates a download of a file from `http://181.223.9.36:9000/linux` and saves it as `/usr/bin/linux`.
2.  It then sets the execute permission for the newly downloaded file.
3.  Finally, it sets the immutable attribute on `/usr/bin/linux`, which prevents its modification or deletion.

Following this, the script determines the number of active processes with the command name "linux".
If zero processes named "linux" are found, the script executes `/usr/bin/linux` in the background.
If more than one process named "linux" is found, the script terminates all processes named "linux".
The script then exits.
